releaseNotes:
Clinexia 4.0.1

New
- Accounts: create an account and sign in from the profile icon in the top bar.
- Premium plans: choose specialty premium or all-access and pay securely with Paystack.
- Every tool now shows whether it is Free or Premium, and which specialty it belongs to.
- Organisations: add your staff and give each person the specialties they need.
- Messages and review forms from the Clinexia team. Tap "Remind me later" and it waits in your profile icon until you are ready.

Improved
- If you have already sent feedback, you will not be asked again.
- Cleaner confirmation pop-ups.
